features.text: DUAL-DESIGN OPTIONS: Available as a pull-on or wraparound style for easy application and comfort.
TARGETED STABILIZATION: Delivers reliable ligament and patellar support for mild to moderate injuries.
BREATHABLE CONSTRUCTION: Lightweight TriTech or 3D neoprene materials provide airflow and durability.
CUSTOM FIT CHOICES: Offered in multiple lengths and materials for tailored compression and flexibility.
ALL-DAY SUPPORT: Ideal for sports, rehabilitation, and arthritis management with a smooth, non-irritating fit.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.

indications: Mild and moderate ACL, PCL, MCL, and LCL sprains
